$comment: Expected model set for the Codex half of the MODEL REGISTRY guard (completion plan P3.8, row 39): the models the
supported Codex CLI itself lists in its model picker, as Claude's half uses the Claude Code model configuration
Source: the models catalogue bundled in the Codex CLI binary (codex-rs models.json), read from the binary's bytes,
never by running it; every model whose visibility is "list", in the catalogue's priority order, with its
display_name. `codex debug models` renders the same catalogue. Hidden entries (visibility "hide": migrated,
internal or review-only models) are not offered and are not listed here.
resources/model-registry.json must carry every id here as a pickable model of the codex family, with that
model's supported_reasoning_levels as its `efforts`; tests/unit/codex-model-registry.test.ts pins it.
Read by src/main/sentinel/sentinel-models.ts, which reports a model listed here that the registry lacks, and a
Codex model the registry offers that this list no longer names. Sentinel reports a stale snapshot after 90 days.
source: the model catalogue bundled with the Codex CLI
